This file reproduces the license notice for github.com/nesleykent/morning-tibia, whose World
Board / Guide NPC text parsing approach (normalized substring matching, a Board reading's
completeness gating whether an absence can be inferred, and "latest Guide reply wins" for
repeated keyword checks) was adapted into src/app/features/morning-tibia.js.

This notice covers that parsing approach only. It does NOT cover the World Change / Mini
World Change catalog data (names, ids, World Board message text, Guide NPC reply text) in
src/data/world-changes.json, which is sourced from TibiaWiki under a separate CC BY-SA data
license — see docs/morning-tibia-sources.md.
